name: office.bootstrap
title: Initialize Office
description: Creates or loads the single-user Office workspace, ensures default rooms and active room exist, and returns a full state snapshot. Idempotent.

client_instance_hint.description: Optional opaque client hint for diagnostics. Not a stable identity.

enforcement: ensure rooms registry seeded (insert-or-ignore core rooms)
ensure office_state exists; if missing set active_room='lobby'
append audit_events with event_type='bootstrap_initialized' only on first creation; otherwise 'bootstrap_loaded' optional
return same response shape as office.state_get
